title: Stateful setup for Read/Write Multiple Registers
purpose: First write one holding register, then issue a valid 0x17 combined read/write request to reach deeper parser and state handling.
expected_behavior: Server should accept the setup write and then parse the 0x17 request that reads one register from 0x0010 and writes one register to 0x0020.
constraints_preserved: both messages have complete MBAP headers
first length is 0006 for unit_id plus 5-byte 0x06 PDU
second length is 000d for unit_id plus 12-byte 0x17 PDU
0x17 field order is read address, read quantity, write address, write quantity, byte count, data
write quantity 0001 matches byte count 02 and one register value
issue_safety_notes: Uses safe minimal counts and does not reproduce any exact 0x17 issue payload.
